about:
Powerex Inc is based in Youngwood, Pennsylvania, where it designs and manufactures high-power semiconductor solutions. The company's founding date and ownership details are not specified in available sources.

The company manufactures a broad portfolio of high-power semiconductor devices, including insulated-gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs), high-voltage IGBTs (HVIGBTs), silicon carbide (SiC) modules and discretes, thyristor and diode modules ranging from 600 V to 11,000 V, and discrete rectifiers and thyristors in disc and stud packages. It also produces custom power modules and integrated power product assemblies, and operates reliability testing and analytical capabilities. The product line includes traction rectifiers for railway applications, with over 8,000 units noted in company communications.

Powerex serves military and aerospace power converter programs and medical imaging amplifier manufacturers. Its traction rectifiers are used in railway systems, converting AC to DC power using silicon diodes and aluminum heat sinks.

The company emphasizes custom module design, offering prototypes and drop-in replacements with validation and qualification support. It has introduced a line of SiC power modules with blocking voltages from 650 V to 10,000 V, aimed at higher power density applications. Flexible online ordering options are also highlighted.
